dataset_name: Nexelin Integration Setup Guide - Client Consultant
description: Detailed step-by-step instructions for setting up all Nexelin integrations

whatsapp.name: WhatsApp Business
questions: How do I set up WhatsApp Business integration step by step?
What are the steps to configure WhatsApp Business?
How to connect WhatsApp to Nexelin?
What credentials do I need for WhatsApp setup?
Where do I find my WhatsApp Business Account ID?
How do I create a permanent access token for WhatsApp?
What webhook URL do I need for WhatsApp?
How do I test if my WhatsApp integration is working?
What if my WhatsApp webhook verification fails?
How do I change my WhatsApp phone number?
How do I generate a WhatsApp QR code?

steps.title: Create a Meta Business Account
instructions: Log in with your Facebook account
Create a Business Manager if prompted
Complete business details (company name, address, phone number)

steps.title: Create a WhatsApp App
instructions: Set an app name (e.g., 'My Business WhatsApp')

steps.title: Add WhatsApp API to your App
instructions: Go to 'WhatsApp' → 'Getting Started' in the left menu
You'll see: Temporary token, Test phone number, Phone Number ID, and WhatsApp Business Account ID (WABA)

steps.title: Add your own phone number
instructions: Confirm by SMS or voice call

steps.title: Generate a permanent access token
instructions: In Business Manager, go to 'Business Settings → Users → System Users'
Create a system user with Admin role
Create a token for this system user

steps.title: Set up Webhook
instructions: In Meta Developers, go to 'WhatsApp → Configuration → Webhooks'
Enter your Verify Token (you'll receive it from Nexelin)
Click 'Manage Subscriptions' and enable: messages, message_template_status_update, and optionally phone_number_quality_update

steps.title: Configure in Nexelin Portal
instructions: Go to Integrations → WhatsApp in your Nexelin portal
Fill in: Meta WABA ID, Meta App ID, Meta App Secret, Meta Access Token, Meta Phone Number ID, your business WhatsApp number, Webhook Verify Token

required_credentials: Meta WABA ID (WhatsApp Business Account ID)

troubleshooting.webhook_verification_fails: Check Callback URL is correct, verify token matches, ensure server is accessible, check SSL certificate
troubleshooting.messages_not_working: Verify webhook is verified, check credentials are correct, ensure phone number is approved, verify access token permissions

telegram.name: Telegram Bot
questions: How do I set up Telegram Bot integration?
How to configure Telegram bot?
How do I get a Telegram bot token?
What webhook URL do I need for Telegram?
How do I test if my Telegram bot is working?
What if my Telegram bot doesn't respond?
How do I regenerate my Telegram bot token?

steps.title: Create a Telegram Bot
instructions: Follow instructions: enter bot name (e.g., 'My Restaurant Bot') and username (must end with 'bot', e.g., 'my_restaurant_bot')
BotFather will send you a Bot Token - save it securely!

steps.title: Configure Bot Settings (Optional)
instructions: Use BotFather commands: /setdescription (set bot description), /setabouttext (set about text), /setuserpic (set bot profile picture)

steps.title: Add Bot Token to Nexelin
instructions: Go to your Nexelin client portal
Paste your Bot Token from BotFather

steps.title: Test your bot
instructions: Search for your bot by username
Your bot should respond using your AI knowledge base

troubleshooting.bot_doesnt_respond: Verify bot token is correct, check webhook is set, ensure knowledge base has content, verify AI model is configured, test in Sandbox

web_chat.name: Web Chat
questions: How do I set up Web Chat?
How to generate Web Chat QR code?
How do I test Web Chat?
How to customize QR codes?

steps.title: Access Web Chat
instructions: Go to Integrations → Web Chat in your Nexelin portal

steps.title: Generate QR Code or Copy Link
instructions: Click 'Generate QR Code' to create a QR code image

steps.title: Share with customers
instructions: Print or display the QR code
Or share the chat link via email, social media, or embed on website

steps.title: Test
instructions: Open the link or scan QR code

features: Supports text messages, voice input, and photo uploads
QR codes can be customized with name, description, and location

web_widget.name: Web Widget
questions: How do I set up Web Widget for my website?
How to embed chat widget on my website?
How do I test Web Widget?
What if Web Widget doesn't appear on my website?

steps.title: Enable Web Widget
instructions: Go to Integrations → Web Widget in your Nexelin portal

steps.title: Copy the Widget Code
instructions: After enabling, you'll see the Widget Code tab

steps.title: Insert into your website
instructions: Paste the widget code BEFORE the </body> tag

steps.title: Test
instructions: Look for chat button 💬 in bottom right corner
Test on mobile - widget shows full-screen interface with close button

features: Full-screen interface on mobile with close button
Uses custom domain for white label clients

troubleshooting.widget_doesnt_appear: Verify white label status, check code is before </body> tag, ensure website is published, check browser console for errors, verify script URL is accessible

email_smtp.name: Email SMTP
questions: How do I set up Email SMTP integration?
How to configure email integration?
What SMTP settings do I need for Gmail?
What SMTP settings do I need for Outlook?
How do I generate a Gmail app password?
How do I test Email integration?
What if Email integration doesn't send emails?
How do I update SMTP password?

steps.title: Access Email SMTP
instructions: Go to Integrations → Email SMTP in your Nexelin portal

steps.title: Enter SMTP Server Details
instructions: SMTP Host (e.g., smtp.gmail.com for Gmail, smtp.office365.com for Outlook)
SMTP Port (usually 587 for TLS or 465 for SSL)
SMTP Password (your email password or app-specific password)
Enable TLS/SSL as required by your email provider

steps.title: Configure Email Settings
instructions: Set 'From' Email Address (the email address that will appear as sender)

steps.title: Save Configuration
instructions: Test by sending a test email if available

gmail_settings.tls: Enable TLS (for port 587) or SSL (for port 465)
gmail_settings.note: You must use an App Password, not your regular Gmail password

outlook_settings.note: May require enabling 'Allow less secure apps' or using app-specific passwords

troubleshooting.emails_not_sending: Verify SMTP credentials, check TLS/SSL settings, ensure port is correct, verify 'From' email is valid, check if app-specific password is needed, ensure firewall allows SMTP connections

general_questions.question: Can I use multiple WhatsApp numbers?
general_questions.answer: Currently, each Nexelin client account supports one WhatsApp Business number. If you need multiple numbers, you can create separate client accounts in Nexelin, each with its own WhatsApp integration.

general_questions.question: Can I use multiple Telegram bots?
general_questions.answer: Currently, each Nexelin client account supports one Telegram bot. If you need multiple bots, you can create separate client accounts, each with its own Telegram bot token.

general_questions.question: Can I customize the chat interface?
general_questions.answer: Yes, for white label clients, you can customize: company logo and name, custom domain for chat interface (webchat_domain), Web Widget uses your branding. Contact support to enable white label features.
